title: Canonical full orthogonal Haar column equals normalized Euclidean surface law
source_anchor: Appendix B.2.2 Proposition B.7 proof: O e_1 is uniform on the unit sphere, before applying Lemma A.1 to U=O_11; Eq21–24 selected Gaussian kernel, actual normalized Euclidean surface-law identification component
target_statement: Canonical background expansion of the source uniform-sphere sentence: for every positive finite dimension \(n\) and every coordinate \(j\), let \(E=\mathbb R^n\), \(S=\{u:\|u\|_2=1\}\), and \(\mu\) be the actual normalized Haar probability on full \(O(n)\). Let \(\tau\) be the actual Euclidean-volume cone surface measure, \(\tau(B)=n\,\mathrm{vol}\{ru:0<r<1,u\in B\}\), and let \(\sigma=\tau(S)^{-1}\iota_*\tau\) on E. Then the actual pushforward \((O\mapsto Oe_j)_*\mu\) equals \(\sigma\). This explicitly generalizes the source use at its first coordinate with \(n\ge3\); it asserts no conditional residual law, independence, Poisson value, or lower bound.
